{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the presence of -1 values and exclude them for mean calculation
valid_ages = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Verify the number of valid entries
num_valid_ages = len(valid_ages)

mean_age, num_valid_ages"}
